title: Arthur Young's quest to invent the Bell helicopter
place_text: US Patent Office, Washington; Bell Helicopter

tellings.quote: So he went to the patent office in in Washington and looked for unsolved problems.

plain: The inventor Arthur Young went to the US Patent Office in Washington looking for problems nobody had solved yet, picked the helicopter, and spent the years from 1926 to 1947 on it, work that led to the Bell helicopter. The psychologist and paranormal researcher Jeffrey Mishlove tells Michels this as something he heard from Young himself. The story shows the kind of deliberate, problem-hunting mind Mishlove says Young had.
